note: Prime on EVM, test network only. PrimeSeat (contracts/evm/prime-seat) has NO persistent deployment from this repository, on Base Sepolia or anywhere else, and no shared instance: an integrating app deploys one PrimeSeat per seat owner and Safe from the creation code below, and checks a deployed seat's runtime against the template hash (runtime with its immutable slots zeroed). The seat is tested on a fork of Base Sepolia against the real Safe 1.4.1 and 1.5.0 L2 contracts (test/PrimeSeatSafe.t.sol, 7 tests), which CI runs against the public RPC. The custody design (Safe, Zodiac Roles, OpenZeppelin TimelockController) ran on Base Sepolia on 29 September 2026 without a seat; its addresses are below as a record of that run, not as Prime deployments. No mainnet deployment exists.

template.note: keccak-256 of the runtime code with the 11 places that hold the three immutables (owner, safe, roles) set to zero; the same for every seat built from this source

custodyRun.note: the custody design test of docs/evm.md (What was tested); no PrimeSeat in it

source.toolchain: Foundry 1.8.4, solc 0.8.28, optimizer 200 runs, via_ir off, OpenZeppelin Contracts 5.4.0
